d:
A major theft has been reported at the Patna residence of Bihar Higher Education Minister Sanjay Singh Tiger.
The thieves allegedly stole around 600 grams of gold, 2 kg of silver and Rs 7 lakh in cash.
The incident took place at his ancestral residence in the AG Colony area under Shastri Nagar police station.
Interestingly, a police patrolling team reportedly passed near the house shortly before the theft but failed to detect the crime.
Police have launched an investigation, with forensic experts and a dog squad examining the spot. CCTV footage is also being checked to identify the culprits.
